newsitem.title: USA: Most IMM currencies end lower, hold overnight lows.
newsitem.headline: Most IMM currencies end lower, hold overnight lows.

text.p: April 8 - Most IMM currency futures closed lower, and managed to hold above overnight lows all day. Most traders said dollar profit-taking and concerns about central bank intervention capped the day's losses. Pesos and Aussie dollars ended higher. June pesos tested $0.123000, a retracement level.
